OpenGWASDB Hybrid Layout — Hybrid vs Dense-of-union

Heterogeneous consortia (BMI · CAD · LDL) · one shared panel · reference-completed

Published

August 4, 2026

Overview

Three independent consortium GWAS, each imputed to a different panel yet genome-wide with a large shared common core — the regime the Hybrid Layout (ADR 0026) targets:

Study Trait
ieu-a-2 Body mass index (GIANT)
ieu-a-7 Coronary heart disease (CARDIoGRAMplusC4D)
ieu-a-300 LDL cholesterol

Both layouts are built from the same three GWAS-VCFs against the same EUR reference panel, and both are reference-completed:

  • Hybrid — a Dense Component on the panel (imputable) + a Ragged Overflow of each study’s off-panel observed variants.
  • Dense-of-union — a single dense matrix over the whole observed union (ADR 0022’s rule applied to this regime), for comparison.

This report compares their storage and query latency, then validates the completed Hybrid store with positive-control imputed-only MR and a regional imputation plot.

Property Value
Analyses (GWAS) 3
Shared variant table (panel ∪ off-panel) 10,394,488
On-panel (Dense Component rows) 9,847,807
Off-panel (Ragged Overflow variants) 546,681
Reference assembly GRCh38

All four stores validate (observed-only and reference-completed, both layouts).

Storage: Hybrid vs Dense-of-union

Form Size
Raw source VCFs (.vcf.gz) 0.41 GB
Dense-of-union (completed) 1.02 GB
Hybrid (completed) 2.33 GB
— Dense Component 1.00 GB
— Ragged Overflow 0.00 GB

The off-panel tail is 5% of the shared variant table (546,681 of 10,394,488 variants). The Hybrid store keeps those raggedly (a variant_index per observed cell) and never imputes them, so its dense matrix — and therefore its dense variant axis, tabix index and ALID mmap — spans only the 9,847,807 imputable panel variants, versus all 10,394,488 in the Dense-of-union store.

Query performance

Median of repeated calls after one warm-up, on the reference-completed stores.

Pattern Hybrid Dense-of-union What it reads
bulk 2.78 s 2.49 s One analysis, all variants (analysis)
phewas 7.7 ms 0.7 ms One (panel) variant × all analyses (phewas)
regional 14.72 s 3.6 ms All associations in a 1 Mb window (range_phewas)
tophits 2.4 ms 1.7 ms ieu-a-300 significant hits from addressed Dense + overflow slices
random_lookup 418.4 ms 32.0 ms 100 variants × analyses (lookup)

On-panel point queries are served by the Dense Component and stay in the low-millisecond range; the Hybrid facade adds only a dispatch + concatenate over the two components. Off-panel PheWAS inherits the ragged O(n) scan (a variant-centric overflow index is deferred, ADR 0026).

Hybrid top_hits(analysis_id=...) delegates the selector to both component indexes, remaps Dense component rows to the shared variant axis, and merges in genomic order without materialising either global tier. For ieu-a-300, the selected query returned 7,909 hits in 2.36 ms median (2.46 ms p95), versus the previous 2.61 ms global read over 14,753 hits. The modest 1.1× speedup is expected for this three-analysis fixture; importantly, the selected path did not regress and exactly matched the corresponding global subset. Rebuilding the completed fixture took 6.72 seconds for the Dense component and 0.09 seconds for the overflow index.

MR validation: imputed-only positive controls

Two positive-control IVW Mendelian randomization runs straight off the store. For the completed Hybrid store each uses only imputed instruments — the exposure top hit and both exposure/outcome lookup cells must be imputed by the Dense Component’s completion — compared against the observed-only estimate.

Exposure → Outcome Observed IVW β Imputed-only IVW β Imputed p
LDL cholesterol → CAD 0.376 (n=74) 0.236 (n=14) 1.2e-21
BMI → CAD 0.407 (n=83) 0.415 (n=6) 1.3e-03

The imputed-only estimates are positive for LDL cholesterol → CAD, BMI → CAD — the expected direction, and consistent with the observed-only estimate. The completed Hybrid store’s imputed dense cells reproduce the causal signal.

Regional imputation sanity check

A 1 Mb window centred on the strongest imputed LDL top hit in the completed Hybrid store; every association returned for the window, imputed highlighted against observed.

  • Analysis: ieu-a-300 (LDL cholesterol)
  • Region: chr19:44,409,976-45,409,976 (centre z=58.03)
  • Associations plotted: 3,962 total; 591 observed, 3,371 imputed.

Provenance

  • Data: opengwasdb_hybrid_ieua_benchmark.json (from benchmarks/benchmark_hybrid_ieua.py).
  • Layout: Hybrid (ADR 0026) — Dense Component (panel) + Ragged Overflow (off-panel observed), reference completion targets the Dense Component only.
  • MR is a demonstration/validation of the query layer, not a definitive epidemiological estimate (distance-based pruning in place of LD clumping).
